title: Brand guidance for products | Designing | Visa Product Design System

blocks.t: Discover essential guidelines for Visa products, including card art, fictitious brands and user aliases, as well as logo creation and naming conventions.
Learn how to ensure Visa brand standards are met when representing digital cards.
Find VPDS-approved fictitious brands and fake user aliases for use in demos and marketing materials.
Learn how to correctly use the Visa name and logo across Visa and non-Visa branded products.
